# A cancelled header drag leaves the body cells swapped and hidden

## Context

Found while verifying #20510 on `dev` at `a903ef6d8d` (`examples/grid/headerGroups`, Chromium, 2600×800, real pointer): pressing Escape in the middle of a header drag restores the headers, but not the body. Captured first as a defect-note; promoted on peer triage as a 13.4 candidate under #20379. Not a 13.4 regression: the cancel branch has been there since #15182 (2026-07-14).

## The Problem

Press `Feb`, drag it onto `Jan` (one in-group swap), press Escape, release. Measured 800ms after the release:

| | `Jan` | `Feb` |
|---|---|---|
| header left (px) | 181 | 331 |
| first-row cell left (px) | 331 | 181 |
| cell visibility | visible | **hidden** |

The headers are back in their order; the body still shows the swap, and the dragged column's cells stay invisible. Any grid with `dragResortable` headers is affected, grouped or not.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Neo.draggable.grid.header.toolbar.SortZone#onDragStart` hides the dragged column's cells (`columnPosition.hidden = true`, `visibility: hidden`), and every header switch moves the body's `columnPositions` and cell styles along with the headers.
- A drop that commits nothing (`startIndex === currentIndex`) runs `processDragEnd`'s no-commit branch: it re-indexes `aria-colindex`, then `owner.passSizeToBody()` rebuilds `columnPositions` from the headers, then `gridBody.createViewData(false, true)` re-renders the rows. That restores the body.
- The cancel path (`drag:cancel` → `container.SortZone#onDragCancel` → `processDragEnd({cancelled: true})`) returns right after `super.processDragEnd`, before that branch: `if (data.cancelled) {me.dragColumnField = null; return}`. The base restores the headers, and nothing restores the body.

Design authority: `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone#onDragCancel` — a cancel applies no transient index, while "the normal end pipeline still owns placeholder/proxy/layout cleanup". The grid body is part of that layout.

## The Fix

In `src/draggable/grid/header/toolbar/SortZone.mjs#processDragEnd`, a cancelled drag skips only the lock-region inference and still runs the no-commit re-sync: `passSizeToBody()` plus `createViewData(false, true)`, and the scrolled-state toolbar re-sync after it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** Escape mid header-drag on `examples/grid/headerGroups`, after at least one swap, leaves every centre header with a visible body cell of its column under it, and the header order unchanged (e2e).
- [ ] **AC-2:** a cancelled drag still changes no column's `locked` (the existing unit test "a cancelled end skips grid lock-region inference after base cleanup" stays green).

## Out of Scope

- Escape over a locked region or during a cross-region drag beyond AC-1's in-centre swap; the restore path is the same.
- The dock tab strip's cancel path (`TabSortZone`), which has no body to re-sync.

## Avoided Traps

- **Walking the switches back on cancel:** the no-commit re-sync already rebuilds the body from the headers; a second restore path would drift from it.
